UK Data Service guide to the older telecom statistics

dedupe_keys.name: oecd broadband and telecom databases broadband portal

description: The OECD broadband and telecom databases hold comparable national statistics on telecommunication networks and markets for OECD member and accession countries, compiled from questionnaires answered by national regulators and statistics offices. The current release in the OECD Data Explorer is a selection of 14 indicators: fixed and mobile broadband subscriptions broken down by technology (DSL, cable, fibre, satellite, fixed wireless, mobile cellular, 5G and machine-to-machine) and by advertised speed band, mobile data usage, telecommunication sector revenue and telecommunication sector investment. The older Telecommunications Database behind the OECD Communications Outlook carried longer series from 1980 on network size, revenues, investment and employment, and remains available through the UK Data Service. Statistics are released twice a year on the Broadband Portal. Coverage: 38 OECD members and some accession countries, with EU, euro-area and G20 aggregates. Format and access: OECD Data Explorer with CSV and SDMX download and an SDMX API, free, reusable under the OECD terms (CC BY 4.0 for most OECD data). Caveats: definitions differ between countries and there are series breaks; revenue and investment are national totals, not per operator or per asset. Simulation uses: economic context for investment appraisal and scenario models of network build-out, and reference figures for subscriptions and traffic by technology. Related records: ITU ICT statistics give worldwide indicators, and national regulator observatories such as ARCEP give detail within one country.
